summary.en: Electric potential is potential energy per unit charge — a property of a location in a field, independent of any particular test charge placed there — so the potential energy of a specific charge is its own charge times the potential at its position.
summary.et: Elektripotentsiaal on potentsiaalne energia laenguühiku kohta — koha omadus väljas, sõltumata sinna asetatud konkreetsest katselaengust — seega konkreetse laengu potentsiaalne energia on tema enda laeng korda potentsiaal tema asukohas.
